chapter: Postwar: Chicago, Vinson, Hines and Cootie
title: The Ink Spots' members
summary: He first met the Ink Spots when with Lloyd Hunter and recalls Bill Kenny, Hoppy Jones and Deek Watson.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: Yes, yeah. Well, he was more addicted and whatnot. He was real committed to it, wasn't he?
Oh, yes. The first time I met him, I was with Lloyd Hunter's band. The Inkspots, Bill Kenny, because Hoppy with with him then, the bass player -- singer.
Played the bass, before he died.
That's -- Deak Watson was the one I was thinking of.
He was with the group then.
And after that, when they broke up, -- well, when Hoppy died, Kenny's brother took over.
Playing the bass, which he never did fill his shoes, really.
No, because that was exceptional, what he did.
Well, anyway, so did you leave the package on the road?
